title: The Smiling Well
author: Tamsin Almeida
blurb: Rafael Sterling, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
